<!doctype html>
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>عرض تفاعلي</title>
<style>:root{--accent:#d6006e;--accent-ink:#ffffff}
[hidden]{display:none!important}:root{--bg:#f3f4f6;--ink:#1f2937;--card:#fff}@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root{--bg:#111318;--ink:#e5e7eb;--card:#1b1e26}}*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Tahoma,sans-serif;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;padding:16px}.bar{width:100%;max-width:1100px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:12px;gap:12px}.dots{display:flex;gap:7px}.dot{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;background:#9ca3af;opacity:.5;transition:.2s}.dot.on{background:var(--accent);opacity:1;transform:scale(1.25);outline:1.5px solid rgba(31,41,55,.45)}.count{font-size:14px;opacity:.75}.restart{border:1px solid #9ca3af;background:transparent;color:inherit;border-radius:8px;padding:6px 12px;font:inherit;cursor:pointer}.stage{position:relative;width:100%;max-width:1100px;background:var(--card);border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.15);overflow:hidden;direction:ltr}.slide{display:none;position:relative;line-height:0;overflow:hidden}.slide.on{display:block}.cam{transform-origin:0 0;transition:transform .5s ease;will-change:transform}.cam img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;user-select:none;-webkit-user-drag:none}.layer{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden;line-height:1.5}.hot{position:absolute;opacity:0;transition:opacity .25s;pointer-events:none;animation:pulse 1.6s infinite}.hot svg{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:visible}.hot path{vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke;fill:none}.hot .o{stroke:rgba(31,41,55,.55);stroke-width:6;pointer-events:none}.hot .m{fill:var(--hbg);stroke:var(--hc);stroke-width:3;pointer-events:visiblePainted;cursor:pointer}.hot.vis{opacity:1}.hot.done{animation:none;opacity:.45}.hot.done .m{fill:rgba(34,197,94,.3);stroke:#16a34a;pointer-events:none;cursor:default}.hot.shake{animation:shake .35s}.hot.tap{animation:tap .25s}.hot .bd{position:absolute;top:-10px;right:-10px;background:#111;color:#fff;font:700 11px/16px system-ui,sans-serif;min-width:18px;text-align:center;border-radius:9px;padding:0 4px;pointer-events:none}@keyframes pulse{0%{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 2px var(--hc))}70%{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 14px transparent)}100%{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 2px transparent)}}@keyframes shake{25%{transform:translateX(-4px)}75%{transform:translateX(4px)}}@keyframes tap{50%{transform:scale(.93)}}.note{position:absolute;display:flex;gap:6px;padding:8px 11px;border-radius:8px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.55;border:1px solid rgba(31,41,55,.3);box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.22);pointer-events:none;opacity:0;transition:opacity .25s;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.note.vis{opacity:1}.explain-label{position:absolute;z-index:5;background:#fff;color:#172033;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;border-radius:9px;padding:7px 10px;font:600 12px/1.5 system-ui,sans-serif;box-shadow:0 5px 16px rgba(15,23,42,.2);text-align:center;overflow-wrap:anywhere;pointer-events:none}.explain-label.active{background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(124,58,237,.18),0 5px 16px rgba(15,23,42,.2)}.hot.auto-active{opacity:1;animation:pulse 1s infinite;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 8px var(--hc))}.hot.blink .m{animation:blinkf 1.2s ease-in-out infinite;animation-delay:var(--bd,0s)}.hot.blink.frame .m{animation:none;fill:none;stroke-dasharray:8 6}@keyframes blinkf{50%{fill:var(--hc);fill-opacity:.55}}.k-note{background:#FFF3B0;color:#3b2f00}.k-alert{background:#FFD0D0;color:#5b1111;border-color:#c0392b}.k-info{background:#CFE6FF;color:#0f3a63}.tip{position:absolute;display:none;opacity:0;transition:opacity .25s;background:var(--hc);color:var(--hi);padding:8px 12px;border-radius:8px;font-size:14px;border:1px solid rgba(31,41,55,.25);box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.25);pointer-events:none;width:max-content}.arrow{position:absolute;display:none;opacity:0;transition:opacity .25s;width:12px;height:12px;background:var(--hc);border:1px solid rgba(31,41,55,.25);transform:rotate(45deg);pointer-events:none}.tip.vis,.arrow.vis{opacity:1}.tip{z-index:6}.tip.inside,.explain-label.inside{text-align:center;line-height:1.3;box-shadow:none;border-radius:6px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.92);color:#172033;border:1px solid rgba(31,41,55,.35)}.explain-label.inside.active{background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink)}.end{position:absolute;inset:0;background:rgba(17,19,24,.72);display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;line-height:1.5}.end.on{display:flex}.end>div{background:var(--card);color:var(--ink);padding:28px 32px;border-radius:14px;text-align:center;max-width:340px}.end h2{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:20px}.end p{margin:0 0 16px;opacity:.8}.end button{background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);border:1px solid rgba(31,41,55,.25);border-radius:8px;padding:9px 18px;font:inherit;cursor:pointer}.end button.ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--ink);border-color:#9ca3af;margin-inline-start:8px}.nav{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-top:12px;align-items:center;justify-content:center}.nav button{border:1px solid #9ca3af;background:var(--card);color:var(--ink);border-radius:8px;padding:9px 20px;font:inherit;cursor:pointer;min-width:110px}.nav button.main{background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-ink);border-color:rgba(31,41,55,.3)}.nav button:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:not-allowed}.hintline{margin-top:10px;font-size:13px;opacity:.6;text-align:center}.tools{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center}@media (max-width:600px){.tip{font-size:11px;padding:5px 8px}.note{font-size:11px;padding:5px 8px}.nav button{padding:8px 12px;min-width:90px}}</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="bar"><div class="count" id="count"></div><div class="dots" id="dots"></div><span class="tools"><button class="restart" id="mute" hidden></button><button class="restart" id="restart"></button></span></div>
<div class="stage" id="stage"><div class="layer" id="layer"><span class="arrow" id="arrow"></span><div class="tip" id="tip"></div></div><div class="end" id="end"><div><h2 id="et"></h2><p id="ep"></p><button id="eb"></button><button id="eb2" class="ghost"></button></div></div></div>
<div class="nav"><button id="prev"></button><button id="next" class="main"></button><button id="snd" hidden></button></div><audio id="aud" preload="auto"></audio>
<div class="hintline" id="hint"></div>
<div class="hintline" id="ainote" hidden></div>
<script>
var CFG={"title":"عرض تفاعلي","color":"#d6006e","dir":"rtl","endTitle":"انتهى العرض","endText":"شكراً لك على المتابعة.","endBtn":"ابدأ من جديد","steps":[{"src":"data:image/png;base64,","displayMode":"interactive","notes":[{"x":0.18061916878710774,"y":0.5228693758141323,"w":0.43,"text":"","kind":"info","at":0}],"hots":[{"pts":[{"x":0.18066157760814247,"y":0.14388519934228788,"w":0.4588634435962681,"h":0.4291357919238079,"shape":"rect","act":"click","tip":""},{"x":0.30632739609838844,"y":0.26401887719148387,"w":0.14588634435962677,"h":0.020500117448589483,"shape":"rect","act":"click","tip":""},{"x":0.32994062765055127,"y":0.31939610070682695,"w":0.11450381679389321,"h":0.02460014093830737,"shape":"rect","act":"click","tip":""}],"tip":"","role":"hint","hintBehavior":"counts","pos":"auto","color":"#f4c542","zoom":2.2,"order":"one","audio":"","tts":false,"ai":false}]},{"src":"data:image/png;base64,","displayMode":"interactive","notes":[],"hots":[]},{"src":"data:image/png;base64,","displayMode":"interactive","notes":[],"hots":[]}]};
var SHAPES={"rect":"M0 0H100V100H0Z","rrect":"M12 0H88Q100 0 100 12V88Q100 100 88 100H12Q0 100 0 88V12Q0 0 12 0Z","square":"M0 0H100V100H0Z","round":"M50 0A50 50 0 1 1 50 100A50 50 0 1 1 50 0Z","tri":"M50 0L100 100L0 100Z","tridown":"M0 0H100L50 100Z","diamond":"M50 0L100 50L50 100L0 50Z","pent":"M50 0L100 38L81 100H19L0 38Z","hex":"M25 0H75L100 50L75 100H25L0 50Z","star":"M50 0L61 35L98 35L68 57L79 91L50 70L21 91L32 57L2 35L39 35Z","arrow":"M0 30H60V0L100 50L60 100V70H0Z","cross":"M33 0H67V33H100V67H67V100H33V67H0V33H33Z","heart":"M50 95C10 65 0 40 0 25C0 10 12 0 25 0C37 0 46 7 50 15C54 7 63 0 75 0C88 0 100 10 100 25C100 40 90 65 50 95Z"};
function svgOf(shape){
  var d=Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(SHAPES,shape)?SHAPES[shape]:SHAPES.rect;
  return '<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" preserveAspectRatio="none"><path class="o" d="'+d+'"/><path class="m" d="'+d+'"/></svg>';
}
function bboxOf(pts){
  var x1=1,y1=1,x2=0,y2=0;
  pts.forEach(function(p){x1=Math.min(x1,p.x);y1=Math.min(y1,p.y);x2=Math.max(x2,p.x+p.w);y2=Math.max(y2,p.y+p.h)});
  return {x:x1,y:y1,w:x2-x1,h:y2-y1};
}
function effZoom(z,b){return Math.max(1,Math.min(z,0.95/Math.max(b.w,b.h,0.01)))}
(function playerMain(CFG){
  var $=function(id){return document.getElementById(id)};
  var stage=$('stage'), layer=$('layer'), arEl=$('arrow'), tipEl=$('tip'), endEl=$('end');
  var rtl=CFG.dir==='rtl';
  var ICON={note:'📝',alert:'⚠️',info:'ℹ️'};
  var L=rtl?{step:function(i,n){return 'الخطوة '+i+' من '+n},restart:'إعادة العرض',prev:'→ السابق',next:'التالي ←',back:'رجوع',hint:'اضغط على المنطقة المضيئة، أو استخدم «التالي» و«السابق»',rem:function(n){return 'اضغط على المناطق المضيئة (المتبقي '+n+')'},snd:'🔊 إعادة الصوت',mt:'🔊 الصوت: مفعّل',mm:'🔇 الصوت: مكتوم',ai:'الصوت مولّد بالذكاء الاصطناعي'}
           :{step:function(i,n){return 'Step '+i+' of '+n},restart:'Restart',prev:'← Back',next:'Next →',back:'Back',hint:'Click the highlighted area, or use Back and Next',rem:function(n){return 'Click the highlighted areas ('+n+' left)'},snd:'🔊 Replay audio',mt:'🔊 Sound: on',mm:'🔇 Sound: muted',ai:'Voice generated by AI'};
  function ink(hex){var n=parseInt(hex.slice(1),16);return (0.299*(n>>16&255)+0.587*(n>>8&255)+0.114*(n&255))>150?'#1f2937':'#ffffff'}
  function hexA(hex,a){var n=parseInt(hex.slice(1),16);return 'rgba('+(n>>16&255)+','+(n>>8&255)+','+(n&255)+','+a+')'}
  var HEX=/^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/i;
  $('restart').textContent=L.restart; $('hint').textContent=L.hint;
  $('prev').textContent=L.prev; $('next').textContent=L.next;
  var aud=$('aud'), sndBtn=$('snd'), muteBtn=$('mute'), muted=false; sndBtn.textContent=L.snd;
  var aiNote=$('ainote'); aiNote.textContent=L.ai;
  $('et').textContent=CFG.endTitle; $('ep').textContent=CFG.endText; $('eb').textContent=CFG.endBtn; $('eb2').textContent=L.back;
  var dotsEl=$('dots'), slides=[], stops=[], cur=0, timer=null, autoTimer=null, autoPoint=0, finished=false, started=false;
  var cs={done:[],idx:0,t:0,tj:-1};

  function anim(e,c){e.classList.remove('shake','tap');void e.offsetWidth;e.classList.add(c);setTimeout(function(){e.classList.remove(c)},380)}

  CFG.steps.forEach(function(s,i){
    var sl=document.createElement('div'); sl.className='slide';
    var cam=document.createElement('div'); cam.className='cam';
    var img=document.createElement('img'); img.src=s.src; img.alt=''; img.draggable=false;
    cam.appendChild(img); sl.appendChild(cam);
    img.addEventListener('click',function(){
      var st=stops[cur]; if(!st||finished||st.i!==i) return;
      if(!st.h){next();return;}
      if(st.h.order==='one'&&(CFG.steps[i].displayMode||'interactive')==='interactive'){next();return;}
      [].forEach.call(layer.querySelectorAll('.hot:not(.done)'),function(e){anim(e,'shake')});
    });
    img.addEventListener('load',function(){ if(started&&stops[cur]&&stops[cur].i===i) relayout(); });
    stage.insertBefore(sl,layer); slides.push({el:sl,cam:cam,img:img});
    var hs=s.hots||[];
    if(hs.length) hs.forEach(function(h,k){stops.push({i:i,h:h,k:k})}); else stops.push({i:i,h:null,k:-1});
  });
  stops.forEach(function(){var d=document.createElement('span');d.className='dot';dotsEl.appendChild(d)});
  if(stops.length>14) dotsEl.style.display='none';

  function target(st){
    var sl=slides[st.i], W=sl.img.clientWidth, H=sl.img.clientHeight;
    if(!W||!H) return null;
    var z=1,cx=W/2,cy=H/2;
    if(st.h&&(CFG.steps[st.i].displayMode||'interactive')!=='explain'){var b=bboxOf(st.h.pts);z=effZoom(Math.max(1,Math.min(5,+st.h.zoom||1)),b);cx=(b.x+b.w/2)*W;cy=(b.y+b.h/2)*H;}
    var tx=Math.max(W-z*W,Math.min(0,W/2-z*cx)), ty=Math.max(H-z*H,Math.min(0,H/2-z*cy));
    return {W:W,H:H,z:z,tx:tx,ty:ty};
  }
  function setCam(sl,T,anim){
    if(!anim) sl.cam.style.transition='none';
    sl.cam.style.transform='translate('+T.tx+'px,'+T.ty+'px) scale('+T.z+')';
    if(!anim){void sl.cam.offsetWidth; sl.cam.style.transition='';}
  }
  function hideOverlay(){
    [].slice.call(layer.querySelectorAll('.hot,.note,.explain-label')).forEach(function(e){e.remove()});
    tipEl.classList.remove('vis'); arEl.classList.remove('vis');
    tipEl.style.display='none'; arEl.style.display='none';
  }
  function setHint(){
    var st=stops[cur],n=0,mode=st&&(CFG.steps[st.i].displayMode||'interactive');
    if(st&&st.h)n=st.h.pts.filter(function(p,j){return !cs.done[j]}).length;
    if(mode==='explain') $('hint').textContent=rtl?'توضيح مباشر: جميع الشروحات ظاهرة':'Explanatory view: all labels are visible';
    else if(mode==='auto') $('hint').textContent=rtl?'يعمل الشرح تلقائياً — يمكنك استخدام التالي والسابق':'Automatic explanation — use Next and Back';
    else if(st&&st.h&&st.h.order==='one') $('hint').textContent=rtl?'اضغط في أي مكان للمتابعة':'Click anywhere to continue';
    else $('hint').textContent=(!finished&&st&&st.h&&st.h.pts.length>1)?L.rem(n):L.hint;
  }
  /* وضع النص داخل الشكل: يصغّر الخط تدريجياً حتى يناسب، ويرجع false إن لم يتّسع */
  function fitInside(e,bx,by,bw,bh){
    if(bw<44||bh<22) return false;
    e.style.maxWidth=Math.max(20,bw-6)+'px';
    for(var fs=14;fs>=9;fs--){
      e.style.fontSize=fs+'px';e.style.padding=(fs>11?'4px 7px':'2px 4px');
      if(e.offsetHeight<=bh-2&&e.offsetWidth<=bw-2){
        e.style.left=(bx+(bw-e.offsetWidth)/2)+'px';e.style.top=(by+(bh-e.offsetHeight)/2)+'px';
        e.classList.add('inside');return true;
      }
    }
    return false;
  }
  function addExplainLabel(p,T,text,active,inPos){
    if(!text)return;
    var W=T.W,H=T.H,e=document.createElement('div');
    e.className='explain-label'+(active?' active':'');e.dir=CFG.dir;e.textContent=text;
    e.style.maxWidth=Math.min(240,Math.max(130,W*.42))+'px';layer.appendChild(e);
    if(inPos==='inside'&&fitInside(e,T.z*p.x*W+T.tx,T.z*p.y*H+T.ty,T.z*p.w*W,T.z*p.h*H)) return;
    e.style.fontSize='';e.style.padding='';e.style.maxWidth=Math.min(240,Math.max(130,W*.42))+'px';
    var px=T.z*(p.x+p.w/2)*W+T.tx, py=T.z*p.y*H+T.ty;
    var x=px-e.offsetWidth/2,y=py-e.offsetHeight-9;
    if(y<4)y=Math.min(H-e.offsetHeight-4,T.z*(p.y+p.h)*H+T.ty+9);
    x=Math.max(4,Math.min(W-e.offsetWidth-4,x));y=Math.max(4,Math.min(H-e.offsetHeight-4,y));
    e.style.left=x+'px';e.style.top=y+'px';
  }
  function scheduleAuto(st){
    clearTimeout(autoTimer);
    autoTimer=setTimeout(function(){
      if(finished||stops[cur]!==st)return;
      if(!st.h){next();return;}
      if(autoPoint+1<st.h.pts.length){autoPoint++;layout(st,target(st));scheduleAuto(st);}
      else next();
    },2600);
  }
  function layout(st,T){
    hideOverlay();
    if(!T) return;
    var W=T.W,H=T.H,g=12,e;
    ((CFG.steps[st.i].notes)||[]).forEach(function(n){
      if(!n.text||((CFG.steps[st.i].displayMode||'interactive')!=='explain'&&n.at>=0&&n.at!==st.k)) return;
      e=document.createElement('div'); e.className='note k-'+n.kind; e.dir=CFG.dir;
      var ic=document.createElement('span'); ic.textContent=ICON[n.kind]||'';
      var tx=document.createElement('span'); tx.textContent=n.text;
      e.appendChild(ic); e.appendChild(tx);
      e.style.width=Math.min(W-12,Math.max(120,n.w*W))+'px'; layer.appendChild(e);
      var nx=Math.max(6,Math.min(W-e.offsetWidth-6,T.z*n.x*W+T.tx)), ny=Math.max(6,Math.min(H-e.offsetHeight-6,T.z*n.y*H+T.ty));
      e.style.left=nx+'px'; e.style.top=ny+'px'; void e.offsetWidth; e.classList.add('vis');
    });
    setHint();
    var mode=CFG.steps[st.i].displayMode||'interactive';
    if(mode==='explain'){
      (CFG.steps[st.i].hots||[]).forEach(function(hh,hi){
        var color=HEX.test(hh.color||'')?hh.color:(hh.role==='hint'?'#f4c542':CFG.color);
        layer.style.setProperty('--hc',color);layer.style.setProperty('--hbg',hexA(color,.3));layer.style.setProperty('--hi',ink(color));
        hh.pts.forEach(function(p,j){
          var el=document.createElement('div');el.className='hot';
          el.style.left=(p.x*W)+'px';el.style.top=(p.y*H)+'px';el.style.width=(p.w*W)+'px';el.style.height=(p.h*H)+'px';
          el.innerHTML=svgOf(p.shape);
          var lb=(hh.pts.length>1?(j+1):'')+(p.act==='dbl'?'×2':'');
          if(lb){var bd=document.createElement('b');bd.className='bd';bd.textContent=lb;el.appendChild(bd)}
          layer.appendChild(el);void el.offsetWidth;el.classList.add('vis');el.style.pointerEvents='none';
          addExplainLabel(p,{W:W,H:H,z:1,tx:0,ty:0},p.tip||hh.tip,false,hh.pos);
        });
      });
      return;
    }
    if(!st.h) return;
    var h=st.h, color=HEX.test(h.color||'')?h.color:(h.role==='hint'?'#f4c542':CFG.color), seq=h.order==='seq'&&mode==='interactive', one=h.order==='one'&&mode==='interactive', pend=[], bigJ=-1;
    if(one&&h.pts.length>1){var ba=0;h.pts.forEach(function(q,j){var a=q.w*q.h;if(a>ba){ba=a;bigJ=j}})}
    layer.style.setProperty('--hc',color); layer.style.setProperty('--hbg',hexA(color,.3)); layer.style.setProperty('--hi',ink(color));
    h.pts.forEach(function(p,j){
      if(seq&&j!==cs.idx) return;
      var dn=mode==='interactive'&&!!cs.done[j]; if(!dn) pend.push(j);
      var el=document.createElement('div'); el.className='hot'+(dn?' done':'')+((mode==='auto'&&j===autoPoint)?' auto-active':'')+(one?(j===bigJ?' blink frame':' blink'):'');
      el.style.left=(T.z*p.x*W+T.tx)+'px'; el.style.top=(T.z*p.y*H+T.ty)+'px';
      el.style.width=(T.z*p.w*W)+'px'; el.style.height=(T.z*p.h*H)+'px';
      el.innerHTML=svgOf(p.shape);
      var lb=one?'':(h.pts.length>1?(j+1):'')+(p.act==='dbl'?'×2':'');
      if(lb){var bd=document.createElement('b');bd.className='bd';bd.textContent=lb;el.appendChild(bd);}
      layer.appendChild(el); void el.offsetWidth; el.classList.add('vis');
      el.addEventListener('click',function(ev){ev.stopPropagation();press(j,el)});
      if(mode!=='interactive') el.style.pointerEvents='none';
      if(mode==='explain'||(mode==='auto'&&j===autoPoint)) addExplainLabel(p,T,p.tip||h.tip,mode==='auto'&&j===autoPoint,h.pos);
      if(one){el.style.setProperty('--bd',(j*0.15)+'s');if(p.tip)addExplainLabel(p,T,p.tip,false,h.pos);}
    });
    if(mode!=='interactive') return;
    if(!pend.length) return;
    var pp=pend.map(function(j){return h.pts[j]}), txt=(pp.length===1&&pp[0].tip)?pp[0].tip:h.tip;
    if(!txt) return;
    var b=bboxOf(pp), hx=T.z*b.x*W+T.tx, hy=T.z*b.y*H+T.ty, hw=T.z*b.w*W, hh=T.z*b.h*H;
    tipEl.textContent=txt; tipEl.dir=CFG.dir; tipEl.style.display='block'; arEl.style.display='block';
    tipEl.style.maxWidth=Math.min(260,W*0.6)+'px';
    tipEl.classList.remove('inside'); tipEl.style.fontSize=''; tipEl.style.padding='';
    if(h.pos==='inside'){
      /* داخل الشكل الأكبر بين النقاط المتبقية؛ إن لم يتّسع النص نرجع للوضع التلقائي */
      var bp=pp[0]; pp.forEach(function(q){if(q.w*q.h>bp.w*bp.h)bp=q});
      if(fitInside(tipEl,T.z*bp.x*W+T.tx,T.z*bp.y*H+T.ty,T.z*bp.w*W,T.z*bp.h*H)){
        arEl.style.display='none'; void tipEl.offsetWidth; tipEl.classList.add('vis'); return;
      }
      tipEl.style.fontSize=''; tipEl.style.padding=''; tipEl.style.maxWidth=Math.min(260,W*0.6)+'px';
    }
    var tw=tipEl.offsetWidth, th=tipEl.offsetHeight, pos=(h.pos&&h.pos!=='inside')?h.pos:'auto';
    if(pos==='auto'){
      var room={below:H-(hy+hh),above:hy,right:W-(hx+hw),left:hx};
      pos=room.below>=th+g+8?'below':room.above>=th+g+8?'above':(room.left>=room.right?'left':'right');
    }
    var x,y;
    if(pos==='below'||pos==='above'){x=hx+hw/2-tw/2;y=pos==='below'?hy+hh+g:hy-th-g;}
    else{y=hy+hh/2-th/2;x=pos==='right'?hx+hw+g:hx-tw-g;}
    x=Math.max(6,Math.min(W-tw-6,x)); y=Math.max(6,Math.min(H-th-6,y));
    tipEl.style.left=x+'px'; tipEl.style.top=y+'px';
    if(pos==='below'||pos==='above'){
      var ax=Math.max(12,Math.min(tw-12,hx+hw/2-x));
      arEl.style.left=(x+ax-6)+'px'; arEl.style.top=(pos==='below'?y-6:y+th-6)+'px';
    }else{
      var ay=Math.max(12,Math.min(th-12,hy+hh/2-y));
      arEl.style.top=(y+ay-6)+'px'; arEl.style.left=(pos==='right'?x-6:x+tw-6)+'px';
    }
    void tipEl.offsetWidth;
    tipEl.classList.add('vis'); arEl.classList.add('vis');
  }
  function press(j,e){
    var st=stops[cur]; if(!st||!st.h||finished||cs.done[j]||(CFG.steps[st.i].displayMode||'interactive')!=='interactive') return;
    if(st.h.role==='hint'&&st.h.hintBehavior==='guide'){anim(e,'tap');return;}
    if(st.h.order==='one'){next();return;}
    var p=st.h.pts[j];
    if(p.act==='dbl'){
      var n=Date.now();
      if(!(cs.tj===j&&n-cs.t<450)){cs.t=n;cs.tj=j;anim(e,'tap');return;}
      cs.t=0;cs.tj=-1;
    }
    cs.done[j]=true;
    if(st.h.pts.every(function(q,k){return cs.done[k]})){next();return;}
    if(st.h.order==='seq'){var k=0;while(cs.done[k])k++;cs.idx=k;}
    layout(st,target(st));
  }
  function relayout(){
    var st=stops[cur]; if(!st||finished) return;
    var T=target(st); if(T){setCam(slides[st.i],T,false);layout(st,T);}
  }
  function hasSound(st){return !!(st&&st.h&&(st.h.audio||(st.h.tts&&st.h.tip&&window.speechSynthesis)))}
  function stopSound(){
    try{aud.pause()}catch(e){}
    try{if(window.speechSynthesis)speechSynthesis.cancel()}catch(e){}
  }
  function playSound(st){
    if(muted||!hasSound(st)) return;
    try{
      if(st.h.audio){aud.src=st.h.audio; aud.currentTime=0; var pr=aud.play(); if(pr&&pr.catch)pr.catch(function(){});}
      else{var u=new SpeechSynthesisUtterance(st.h.tip); u.lang=rtl?'ar':'en'; speechSynthesis.speak(u);}
    }catch(e){}
  }
  muteBtn.hidden=!stops.some(hasSound); muteBtn.textContent=L.mt;
  function nav(){
    $('prev').disabled=(cur===0&&!finished);
    $('next').disabled=finished;
    sndBtn.hidden=finished||!hasSound(stops[cur]);
    aiNote.hidden=finished||!(stops[cur]&&stops[cur].h&&stops[cur].h.audio&&stops[cur].h.ai);
    [].forEach.call(dotsEl.children,function(d,k){d.classList.toggle('on',k===cur)});
    $('count').textContent=L.step(cur+1,stops.length);
    setHint();
  }
  function sendH(){try{parent.postMessage({demoHeight:document.body.offsetHeight},'*')}catch(e){}}
  function show(k,instant){
    var prevStop=stops[cur], st=stops[k];
    var animate=!instant&&started&&prevStop&&prevStop.i===st.i;
    started=true; cur=k; finished=false; endEl.classList.remove('on');
    clearTimeout(autoTimer); autoPoint=0;
    cs={done:[],idx:0,t:0,tj:-1};
    slides.forEach(function(s,j){s.el.classList.toggle('on',j===st.i)});
    hideOverlay(); stopSound(); clearTimeout(timer);
    var T=target(st);
    if(T) setCam(slides[st.i],T,animate);
    timer=setTimeout(function(){layout(st,target(st));playSound(st);sendH();if((CFG.steps[st.i].displayMode||'interactive')==='auto')scheduleAuto(st);},animate?520:40);
    nav(); sendH();
  }
  function next(){
    if(finished) return;
    var k=cur+1;
    if(stops[cur]&&(CFG.steps[stops[cur].i].displayMode||'interactive')==='explain'){
      while(k<stops.length&&stops[k].i===stops[cur].i)k++;
    }
    if(k<stops.length) show(k);
    else{finished=true; clearTimeout(timer); clearTimeout(autoTimer); hideOverlay(); stopSound(); endEl.classList.add('on'); nav();}
  }
  function prev(){
    if(finished){finished=false; show(cur,true); return;}
    var k=cur-1;
    if(stops[cur]&&(CFG.steps[stops[cur].i].displayMode||'interactive')==='explain'){
      while(k>=0&&stops[k].i===stops[cur].i)k--;
    }
    if(k>=0)show(k);
  }
  $('next').onclick=next; $('prev').onclick=prev;
  sndBtn.onclick=function(){var w=muted; muted=false; stopSound(); playSound(stops[cur]); muted=w;};
  muteBtn.onclick=function(){muted=!muted; muteBtn.textContent=muted?L.mm:L.mt; if(muted)stopSound(); else playSound(stops[cur]);};
  $('restart').onclick=function(){show(0,true)}; $('eb').onclick=function(){show(0,true)}; $('eb2').onclick=prev;
  document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
    if(e.key==='ArrowRight'){rtl?prev():next();}
    else if(e.key==='ArrowLeft'){rtl?next():prev();}
  });
  var rt=null;
  window.addEventListener('resize',function(){clearTimeout(rt);rt=setTimeout(relayout,80)});
  if(stops.length) show(0,true);
})(CFG);
</script>
</body>
</html>
